text:
Avery: Heads up: deploybot is blocking the canary promote for v2.9.0. CI verify reported an artifact checksum mismatch between the registry manifest and what our runner cache returned. Change window ends in ~45m. Quick call: pin to previous canary or attempt rebuild+upload inside the window?

Deploy-bot: promotion-check failed for image redwood/edge-gateway@sha256:7f4d1c
expected: sha256:7f4d1c
observed-in-runner-cache-21: sha256:2b6e9a
action: promotion blocked; manual decision required

Nora: Runner logs indicate runner-cache-21 returned a different blob header. There was a purge job yesterday but it looks like this shard didn't sync.

Diego: If we try a rebuild now, we risk hitting the same stale cache. Rebuild+upload estimate ~22m but if the cache still serves stale blobs we'd be stuck. My leaning: pin to last good canary sha256:99aabb and avoid extending the window.

Priya: Product is waiting on a small UX tweak in this release. If we pin, we need to communicate to product immediately and update release notes mentioning the pin and follow-up rebuild. I can update notes & notify PMs.

QA-bot: quick smoke checklist: after manual promote, run smoke-suite with timeout 10m and failure threshold 0.8% http_5xx. Add ephemeral alert: canary_http_5xx > 0.8% for 10m.

Avery: Sounds like pin+rebuild later is safest. Who can run the manual promote and watch the smoke? Victor?

Victor: I can take it. Command I will issue:```/deploybot promote --image sha256:99aabb --env canary --meta "pin-checksum-mismatch"```I'll watch metrics for 15m and abort if http_5xx_rate > 0.8% or p95 latency rises > 150ms. Also will post a short blurb for release-notes.

Nora: I'll open a rebuild PR with an explicit cache-bust flag and a verification job that pulls the uploaded image back from registry and verifies sha256 before any promote. CI snippet I'll add:
```
ci/pipeline.yaml:
  steps:
    - name: build
      run: ./ci/build-image --tag=v2.9.0-canary-rebuild --cache-bust
    - name: upload
      run: ./ci/upload --atomic --verify-sha256
    - name: verify
      run: ./ci/pull-and-verify --image=v2.9.0-canary-rebuild --expected-sha256=7f4d1c
```

Diego: I'll schedule a runner-cache-21 purge and attach it to an incident in registry-monitoring. If the purge finishes quickly we can attempt an out-of-band rebuild and re-verify before stable promote.

Deploy-bot: Manual promote command received from Victor. Status: queued -> deploying -> smoke-run started. :eyes:

Victor: Smoke at +5m: error-rate 0.15%, latency stable. Still monitoring. Also adding temporary alert: canary_error_rate > 0.8% for 10m.

Avery: Priya please update release-notes/drafts/2.9.x with: "Canary promotion temporarily pinned to previous canary sha256:99aabb due to artifact checksum mismatch; rebuild scheduled and verification to follow. See incident INC-2026-14." Include rollback steps and link to the rebuild PR when available.

Priya: Updating notes now and notifying PMs. Will include a short rollback playbook:```/deploybot promote --image sha256:7f4d1c --env canary --reason "rollback to blocked image after verified rebuild"```

Deploy-bot: smoke-run passed. Canary promoted to sha256:99aabb. Promotion complete.

Diego: Purge for runner-cache-21 started and attached to INC-2026-14. ETA ~6m. After purge I'll coordinate a rebuild job with --cache-bust and upload verify. Nora, please link the rebuild PR when ready.

Nora: PR opened: "ci: rebuild v2.9.0-canary with cache-bust and registry verify". CI will run the verify stage and only allow promote if downloaded sha256 matches expected.

Victor: Watch complete at +15m. No anomalies. Closing watch.

Avery: Summary + action items: Victor manual promote + watched, Nora PR + CI verify, Diego purge runner-cache-21 and monitor registry incident, Priya update release notes and notify product. We'll schedule the verified rebuild overnight and re-promote to stable after clean verification. Reopen thread if any post-promote metrics spike. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
